zzz.sense: intj: A snoring sound, implying that somebody is asleep.
zzz.hook: Wiktionary gives no earlier form for this sense.

firstUse.quote: He lay back on his pillow, made a faint zzzing sound that ceased, and presently and quite quietly he died — greatly comforted by my assurance.

zzzs.hook: Wiktionary gives no earlier form for this sense.

firstUse.quote: The harder you try to sleep, the greater the chances you'll end up gnashing your teeth all night rather than stacking some Zzzs.
firstUse.source: 2002, The Doctors Book of Home Remedies:
